SELECT c.id, c.document_id, ts_rank_cd(c.search_vector, plainto_tsquery('simple', $1)) * (CASE WHEN CASE WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page-truth://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 14) WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 8) ELSE d.source_path END LIKE 'media/articles/%' THEN 1.1 WHEN CASE WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page-truth://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 14) WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 8) ELSE d.source_path END LIKE 'media/repos/%' THEN 1.1 WHEN CASE WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page-truth://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 14) WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 8) ELSE d.source_path END LIKE 'originals/%' THEN 1.5 WHEN CASE WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page-truth://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 14) WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 8) ELSE d.source_path END LIKE 'companies/%' THEN 1.2 WHEN CASE WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page-truth://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 14) WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 8) ELSE d.source_path END LIKE 'concepts/%' THEN 1.3 WHEN CASE WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page-truth://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 14) WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 8) ELSE d.source_path END LIKE 'meetings/%' THEN 1.1 WHEN CASE WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page-truth://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 14) WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 8) ELSE d.source_path END LIKE 'extracts/%' THEN 0.3 WHEN CASE WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page-truth://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 14) WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 8) ELSE d.source_path END LIKE 'writing/%' THEN 1.4 WHEN CASE WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page-truth://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 14) WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 8) ELSE d.source_path END LIKE 'media/x/%' THEN 0.7 WHEN CASE WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page-truth://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 14) WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 8) ELSE d.source_path END LIKE 'archive/%' THEN 0.5 WHEN CASE WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page-truth://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 14) WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 8) ELSE d.source_path END LIKE 'people/%' THEN 1.2 WHEN CASE WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page-truth://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 14) WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 8) ELSE d.source_path END LIKE 'deals/%' THEN 1.2 WHEN CASE WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page-truth://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 14) WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 8) ELSE d.source_path END LIKE 'daily/%' THEN 0.8 WHEN CASE WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page-truth://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 14) WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 8) ELSE d.source_path END LIKE 'chat/%' THEN 0.5 ELSE 1.0 END) AS score FROM chunks c JOIN documents d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE c.search_vector @@ plainto_tsquery('simple', $1) AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT d.archived AND NOT (COALESCE(d.frontmatter, '{}'::jsonb) ? 'quarantine') AND NOT (CASE WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page-truth://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 14) WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 8) ELSE d.source_path END LIKE 'test/%' OR CASE WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page-truth://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 14) WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 8) ELSE d.source_path END LIKE 'attachments/%' OR CASE WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page-truth://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 14) WHEN d.source_path LIKE 'page://%' THEN substr(d.source_path, 8) ELSE d.source_path END LIKE '.raw/%') ORDER BY score DESC, c.id COLLATE "C" ASC LIMIT $2

SELECT c.id, c.document_id, c.content, d.source_path, d.title, d.source_id, d.effective_date::text AS effective_date, d.updated_at::text AS updated_at FROM chunks c JOIN documents d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE c.id = ANY($1::text[]) AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT d.archived AND NOT (COALESCE(d.frontmatter, '{}'::jsonb) ? 'quarantine')

SELECT 'chunks' AS kind, c.id::text AS id, (LEAST(COALESCE(CASE d.trust_tier WHEN 'owner' THEN 3 WHEN 'member' THEN 2 WHEN 'agent' THEN 1 WHEN 'external' THEN 0 END, 3), CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sources tt_s WHERE tt_s.id = d.source_id AND tt_s.kind IN ('github', 'mailbox', 'calendar', 'webhook', 'chat', 'meeting')) THEN 0 ELSE 3 END, COALESCE((SELECT MIN(LEAST(COALESCE(CASE p.trust_tier WHEN 'owner' THEN 3 WHEN 'member' THEN 2 WHEN 'agent' THEN 1 WHEN 'external' THEN 0 END, 3), CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sources tt_s WHERE tt_s.id = p.source_id AND tt_s.kind IN ('github', 'mailbox', 'calendar', 'webhook', 'chat', 'meeting')) THEN 0 ELSE 3 END, CASE WHEN p.compiled_truth->>'provider' = 'github' THEN 0 ELSE 3 END, COALESCE((SELECT MIN(CASE WHEN tt_v.written_by = 'connector-github' THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN tt_v.written_by_principal IS NULL OR tt_v.written_by_principal IN ('', 'operator') THEN 3 WHEN tt_v.written_by_principal LIKE 'member:%' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END END) FROM page_versions tt_v WHERE tt_v.slug = p.slug AND tt_v.source_id = p.source_id), 3))) FROM pages p WHERE p.source_id = COALESCE(d.source_id, 'default') AND d.source_path IN (CASE WHEN p.source_id = 'default' THEN 'page://' || p.slug ELSE 'page://' || p.source_id || '/' || p.slug END, CASE WHEN p.source_id = 'default' THEN 'page-truth://' || p.slug ELSE 'page-truth://' || p.source_id || '/' || p.slug END, p.slug, p.slug || '.md', p.slug || '.markdown')), 3)))::int AS rank FROM chunks c JOIN documents d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE c.id = ANY($1::text[])

sql.text: SELECT c.id, c.chunk_index, c.content, c.symbol_name FROM chunks c JOIN documents d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE d.source_path = $1 AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT (COALESCE(d.frontmatter, '{}'::jsonb) ? 'quarantine') ORDER BY c.chunk_index, c.id LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3

SELECT 'chunks' AS kind, c.id::text AS id, (LEAST(COALESCE(CASE d.trust_tier WHEN 'owner' THEN 3 WHEN 'member' THEN 2 WHEN 'agent' THEN 1 WHEN 'external' THEN 0 END, 3), CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sources tt_s WHERE tt_s.id = d.source_id AND tt_s.kind IN ('github', 'mailbox', 'calendar', 'webhook', 'chat', 'meeting')) THEN 0 ELSE 3 END, COALESCE((SELECT MIN(LEAST(COALESCE(CASE p.trust_tier WHEN 'owner' THEN 3 WHEN 'member' THEN 2 WHEN 'agent' THEN 1 WHEN 'external' THEN 0 END, 3), CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sources tt_s WHERE tt_s.id = p.source_id AND tt_s.kind IN ('github', 'mailbox', 'calendar', 'webhook', 'chat', 'meeting')) THEN 0 ELSE 3 END, CASE WHEN p.compiled_truth->>'provider' = 'github' THEN 0 ELSE 3 END, COALESCE((SELECT MIN(CASE WHEN tt_v.written_by = 'connector-github' THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN tt_v.written_by_principal IS NULL OR tt_v.written_by_principal IN ('', 'operator') THEN 3 WHEN tt_v.written_by_principal LIKE 'member:%' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END END) FROM page_versions tt_v WHERE tt_v.slug = p.slug AND tt_v.source_id = p.source_id), 3))) FROM pages p WHERE p.source_id = COALESCE(d.source_id, 'default') AND d.source_path IN (CASE WHEN p.source_id = 'default' THEN 'page://' || p.slug ELSE 'page://' || p.source_id || '/' || p.slug END, CASE WHEN p.source_id = 'default' THEN 'page-truth://' || p.slug ELSE 'page-truth://' || p.source_id || '/' || p.slug END, p.slug, p.slug || '.md', p.slug || '.markdown')), 3)))::int AS rank FROM chunks c JOIN documents d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE c.id = ANY($1::text[])

SELECT c.id::text AS id, d.frontmatter -> 'content_flag' ->> 'detail' AS detail FROM chunks c JOIN documents d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE c.id::text = ANY($1::text[]) AND d.frontmatter -> 'content_flag' ->> 'reason' = $2

SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(id ORDER BY id) FILTER (WHERE federated OR id = $1), '{}') AS federated, COALESCE(array_agg(id ORDER BY id) FILTER (WHERE NOT federated AND id <> $1), '{}') AS isolated FROM sources

SELECT slug, type, title, compiled_truth, markdown_body, content_hash, source_id, created_at::text AS created_at, updated_at::text AS updated_at, deleted_at::text AS deleted_at FROM pages WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY pages.updated_at DESC, slug COLLATE "C" ASC LIMIT $1

SELECT d.source_path, COALESCE(d.source_id, 'default') AS source_id, d.frontmatter FROM documents d JOIN unnest($1::text[], $2::text[]) AS requested(path, source_id) ON d.source_path = requested.path AND COALESCE(d.source_id, 'default') = requested.source_id

SELECT slug, type, title, compiled_truth, markdown_body, content_hash, source_id, created_at::text AS created_at, updated_at::text AS updated_at, deleted_at::text AS deleted_at, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(v.version_n), 0) FROM page_versions v WHERE v.slug = pages.slug)::int AS version FROM pages WHERE slug = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE pages SET last_retrieved_at = NOW() WHERE slug = ANY($1::text[]) AND deleted_at IS NULL AND source_id = $2 AND (last_retrieved_at IS NULL OR last_retrieved_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes')

SELECT d.source_path, COALESCE(d.source_id, 'default') AS source_id, d.frontmatter FROM documents d JOIN unnest($1::text[], $2::text[]) AS requested(path, source_id) ON d.source_path = requested.path AND COALESCE(d.source_id, 'default') = requested.source_id

(SELECT id, source_slug, target_slug, type, inferred_confidence, source_chunk_id, written_at::text AS written_at, 'outbound' AS direction FROM links WHERE source_slug = $1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pages hp WHERE hp.slug = links.source_slug AND (hp.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM documents hd WHERE hd.source_path = CASE WHEN hp.source_id IS NULL OR hp.source_id = 'default' THEN 'page://' || hp.slug ELSE 'page://' || hp.source_id || '/' || hp.slug END AND (hd.archived OR NOT NOT (COALESCE(hd.frontmatter, '{}'::jsonb) ? 'quarantine'))))) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pages hp WHERE hp.slug = links.target_slug AND (hp.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM documents hd WHERE hd.source_path = CASE WHEN hp.source_id IS NULL OR hp.source_id = 'default' THEN 'page://' || hp.slug ELSE 'page://' || hp.source_id || '/' || hp.slug END AND (hd.archived OR NOT NOT (COALESCE(hd.frontmatter, '{}'::jsonb) ? 'quarantine'))))) ORDER BY written_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $2) UNION ALL (SELECT id, source_slug, target_slug, type, inferred_confidence, source_chunk_id, written_at::text AS written_at, 'inbound' AS direction FROM links WHERE target_slug = $1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pages hp WHERE hp.slug = links.source_slug AND (hp.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM documents hd WHERE hd.source_path = CASE WHEN hp.source_id IS NULL OR hp.source_id = 'default' THEN 'page://' || hp.slug ELSE 'page://' || hp.source_id || '/' || hp.slug END AND (hd.archived OR NOT NOT (COALESCE(hd.frontmatter, '{}'::jsonb) ? 'quarantine'))))) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pages hp WHERE hp.slug = links.target_slug AND (hp.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM documents hd WHERE hd.source_path = CASE WHEN hp.source_id IS NULL OR hp.source_id = 'default' THEN 'page://' || hp.slug ELSE 'page://' || hp.source_id || '/' || hp.slug END AND (hd.archived OR NOT NOT (COALESCE(hd.frontmatter, '{}'::jsonb) ? 'quarantine'))))) ORDER BY written_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $2)
SELECT a.canonical_slug FROM slug_aliases a JOIN pages p ON p.slug = a.canonical_slug AND p.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE a.alias_slug = $1 ORDER BY a.id LIMIT 1
SELECT 1 AS one FROM pages WHERE slug = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT pa.slug AS slug FROM page_aliases pa JOIN pages p ON p.slug = pa.slug AND p.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE pa.alias_norm = $1 LIMIT 2
SELECT p.slug AS slug FROM pages p WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.slug <> $2 AND p.slug LIKE '%/%' AND regexp_replace(p.slug, '^.*/', '') = $1 LIMIT 2

SELECT p.slug AS slug FROM pages p WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.slug <> $2 AND p.slug LIKE '%/%' AND regexp_replace(p.slug, '^.*/', '') LIKE $1 || '%' AND regexp_replace(p.slug, '^.*/', '') <> $1 LIMIT 2

SELECT p.slug AS slug, GREATEST( similarity(lower(COALESCE(p.title, '')), lower($1)), similarity(regexp_replace(p.slug, '^.*/', ''), $2) ) AS sim FROM pages p WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.slug <> $3 ORDER BY sim DESC, p.slug ASC LIMIT 2

SELECT p.slug AS slug, p.source_id AS source_id, p.title AS title, COUNT(*)::int AS mention_count, MIN(l.target_slug) AS target_slug FROM links l JOIN pages p ON p.slug = l.source_slug AND p.source_id = l.source_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE l.target_slug = ANY($1::text[]) GROUP BY p.slug, p.source_id, p.title ORDER BY mention_count DESC, max(l.id) DESC, p.slug, p.source_id LIMIT $2
SELECT id, source_path FROM documents WHERE source_path = ANY($1::text[]) ORDER BY id

SELECT d.id AS document_id, d.source_path AS source_path, d.title AS title, COUNT(*)::int AS mention_count, MIN(em.surface_form) AS surface_form FROM entity_mentions em JOIN chunks c ON c.id = em.chunk_id JOIN documents d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE em.entity_id = $1 GROUP BY d.id, d.source_path, d.title ORDER BY mention_count DESC, d.title NULLS LAST, d.source_path LIMIT $2
SELECT tag FROM tags WHERE slug = $1 ORDER BY tag COLLATE "C" ASC
SELECT slug, title FROM pages p WHERE slug = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT slug, title, GREATEST( similarity(lower(COALESCE(title, '')), lower($1)), similarity(slug, lower($1)) ) AS score FROM pages p WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND GREATEST( similarity(lower(COALESCE(title, '')), lower($1)), similarity(slug, lower($1)) ) >= $2 ORDER BY score DESC, slug ASC LIMIT $3

SELECT p.slug, p.title, p.source_id FROM pages p WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND lower(btrim(p.type)) = 'person' AND p.title IS NOT NULL AND p.slug NOT LIKE 'life/diary/%' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pages hp WHERE hp.slug = p.slug AND (hp.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM documents hd WHERE hd.source_path = CASE WHEN hp.source_id IS NULL OR hp.source_id = 'default' THEN 'page://' || hp.slug ELSE 'page://' || hp.source_id || '/' || hp.slug END AND (hd.archived OR NOT NOT (COALESCE(hd.frontmatter, '{}'::jsonb) ? 'quarantine'))))) ORDER BY p.slug COLLATE "C" LIMIT 2001

SELECT l.target_slug AS slug, count(DISTINCT l.source_slug)::int AS n FROM links l JOIN pages p ON p.slug = l.source_slug AND p.source_id = l.source_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE l.target_slug = ANY($1::text[]) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pages hp WHERE hp.slug = l.source_slug AND (hp.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM documents hd WHERE hd.source_path = CASE WHEN hp.source_id IS NULL OR hp.source_id = 'default' THEN 'page://' || hp.slug ELSE 'page://' || hp.source_id || '/' || hp.slug END AND (hd.archived OR NOT NOT (COALESCE(hd.frontmatter, '{}'::jsonb) ? 'quarantine'))))) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pages hp WHERE hp.slug = l.target_slug AND (hp.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM documents hd WHERE hd.source_path = CASE WHEN hp.source_id IS NULL OR hp.source_id = 'default' THEN 'page://' || hp.slug ELSE 'page://' || hp.source_id || '/' || hp.slug END AND (hd.archived OR NOT NOT (COALESCE(hd.frontmatter, '{}'::jsonb) ? 'quarantine'))))) GROUP BY l.target_slug
SELECT id, kind, path_prefix, sync_policy, indexed_policy, rate_limit_per_minute, respect_quiet_hours, boost_weight, description, federated FROM sources ORDER BY path_prefix

SELECT slug, source_id, version_n, hash_prev, hash_new, written_by, change_reason, written_at::text AS written_at, written_by_principal FROM page_versions WHERE slug = $1 ORDER BY version_n DESC LIMIT $2

SELECT d.source_path, COALESCE(d.source_id, 'default') AS source_id, d.frontmatter FROM documents d JOIN unnest($1::text[], $2::text[]) AS requested(path, source_id) ON d.source_path = requested.path AND COALESCE(d.source_id, 'default') = requested.source_id
